purpose: Teach: 洗脳/疾病/空想/部族/拷問/国営/改変/公営

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、メディアの洗脳効果を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you were working on that paper about media's power to persuade, weren't you?
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Gentle confirmation—not testing, genuinely interested. Slight upward lilt at the end, encouraging him to expand. Relaxed pacing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、希少疾病の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, actually that paper was on rare disease research.
lines.style: Soft, slightly apologetic correction. A small pause before answering, as if gathering his thoughts. Careful articulation. No defensiveness, just setting the record straight.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ユートピアの空想小説を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Oh, and the utopian fiction one—you were exploring that in your thesis, right?
lines.style: Gently probing, almost musing aloud. A teacher checking her own memory while drawing him out. Unhurried, warm. Slight questioning lilt, inviting clarification.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、少数部族の文化を論文で扱いました
lines.en: That was actually about minority cultures and ethnography.
lines.style: Quiet, patient correction. No irritation—just accuracy mattering to him. Slight emphasis on the actual topic. Even delivery, grounded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史上の拷問を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And the historical torture piece—that was one of yours too, wasn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reflective. She's sorting through her notes mentally. Steady, curious tone. No judgment in the topic itself, just scholarly interest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、国営事業の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, that paper focused on the history of state enterprises.
lines.style: Clear, steady correction. A slight pause beforehand—he's used to gently redirecting her. Respectful but matter-of-fact. No strain in his voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文書の改変を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Right, and then the piece on document alteration—I remember that one vividly.
lines.style: More engaged now, as if a memory has clicked into place. Brighter tone, slightly quicker pace. Still warm but more animated than before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、公営住宅の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, that was my research on public housing history.
lines.style: Final, gentle correction. A touch of weariness beneath the politeness—he's explained this a few times. Soft trailing at the end. Still kind, but the correction lands more firmly.
